|nationality=Andoran}}'''Elise Strang''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|223}}.

==History==

Elise's name could indicate [[Andor|Andoran]] origin (see [[Kairen Stang]], [[Elisa al'Seen]], [[Elisa al'Vere]], and [[Elise Marwin]]).

Elise held the position for twenty-one years until her death in {{Ne|244}}. She was [[Catala Lucanvalle]]'s successor and [[Comarra Zepava]]'s predecessor.{{ref/book|bwb|24}}

She was such a weak Amyrlin that she had to beg to have what she wanted from the [[Hall of the Tower|Hall]].
